abstract: The AI Resilience Report by CareerVillage.org aggregates multiple AI exposure datasets and combines them with employment projections to produce occupation-specific AI resilience scores. Designed for students and entry-level professionals navigating the labor market as AI integrates into work, it contextualizes results through analysis, occupation-specific news feeds, and exploration tools. The project takes a measured stance: skeptical of doomsday timelines while aiming to offer the clearest possible picture of the current moment.
keyFindings: Provides occupation-specific AI resilience scores combining multiple AI exposure datasets with employment projections.
Targeted at students and entry-level professionals navigating AI-driven labor market changes.
Contextualizes resilience scores with analysis, occupation-specific news feeds, and exploration opportunities.
Takes a balanced, evidence-based stance: skeptical of doomsday timelines, focused on current data.
methodology: Aggregates multiple AI exposure datasets and combines with employment projections into AI resilience scores. Specific datasets and weighting methodology not detailed in the about page. Created by CareerVillage.org, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that has served 7 million learners from 190 countries since 2011.
qualifiers: Site is in beta and actively being updated; may contain errors or require improvement. Not affiliated with Anthropic, Microsoft, or any other data provider.
